Shawn, everything on Shop···· has been delivered. The NerdOctaxe arrived September 10, and the Thor P2 was delivered November 6 by Amazon Shipping ((number hidden)).

The power supply is the one thing still open. Your test results from the 7th showed the Octaxe starts up fine on the Thor's power supply, which points to the brick. I'm sorry you still haven't had an answer. I've passed it to the team again with those results, and someone will get back to you by email about the replacement.

It has now been 7 business days that I have been trying to get  replacement power supply brick.  What in the world is the holdup?  This is not a complicated resolution - I've done 2 rounds of testing that both proved the same thing.  Unless there is something in the photos that indicates a bigger problem, why is the replacement brick not in the mail?

You're right, Shawn, and I'm sorry. Your two rounds of testing both point to the brick, and I don't see anything on my side that suggests a bigger problem.

The holdup is on us. Sending a replacement part needs a sign-off from someone on the team, and I can't send it myself. That's why it's been stuck, and it shouldn't have taken 7 business days.

The ticket I raised a few minutes ago is with them now, along with your test results. I won't give you a date I can't stand behind. Someone will email you with the answer.

I can't promise today, Shawn, and after a week of missed promises I'm not going to make another one. The team is working until 6pm ET today and your ticket is in front of them now with your test results. The reply will come to this email as soon as someone signs off on the brick.
Just checking back in, as I haven't received any emails or information about the replacement brick.
